positiveReasons.point: Demonstrates deep Go expertise with two production-grade Go backends (vexaro, Gnat) using Go 100% and 46% respectively, both with active maintenance and real deployments.
Shows Next.js mastery with three live, Vercel-hosted Next.js apps (varsityline, diffboard, phantomscrape-frontend) using Next.js 100% in each, all with App Router and TypeScript.
Proves Postgres experience through two projects (Gnat, wildpalace-seo-plp) explicitly supporting Postgres in their verified stacks, with Gnat also supporting MySQL and SQLite interchangeably.
Evidence of sustained, recent activity: 42 commits in the last 90 days for vexaro, 32 for Gnat, and 15 for varsityline, all with clear patterns of ongoing refinement.
All claimed deployments are verified live, including Vercel-hosted Next.js apps and Go backends with real API endpoints.
Architectural depth demonstrated in wildpalace-seo-plp, a full-stack Shopify app with Prisma/Postgres, AI integration, and complex state management.
External contribution to a high-profile open-source project (sourcebot-dev/sourcebot) with a merged PR, showing collaborative experience.
MCP (Multi-Tool Context Protocol) integration across multiple projects (vexaro, varsityline, Gnat), demonstrating experience with AI-agent tooling.
Production-grade testing and validation patterns in vexaro, including versioned data diffing, rollback, and schema validation.
Diverse database experience: MySQL (vexaro), SQLite (Gnat), and Supabase/Postgres (varsityline, wildpalace-seo-plp, phantomscrape-frontend).

negativeReasons.point: No explicit evidence of direct Next.js API route integration with Go backends in the same repo, though this is not required for a full-stack role.
